title: Swap the Mining Laser I for a Mining Laser II at Confederacy Central Command, Sol (fit with replace), Solarian-born miners, one at a time
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 03:09 UTC (orders ENT-071, O2 and block ZERO: the stronger lasers; rules F12, F17, F37).
